summary: Serverless architecture combining React Native (Expo) frontend and Spring Boot backend with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL hosted on AWS ECS Fargate. Estimated monthly infrastructure cost ranges from $170 to $555.

frontend.justification: Cross-platform architecture supporting Android, iOS, and Web from a unified TypeScript/JavaScript codebase with offline SQLite support.

alternatives.why_not: Team skills center on JavaScript/TypeScript rather than Dart.

tradeoffs: Native platform bridges required for specialized hardware integrations.

backend.justification: Industry-standard enterprise framework providing robust ACID transaction boundaries, mature double-entry accounting libraries, and compliance support for RBI and PCI-DSS.

alternatives.why_not: Python lacks enterprise transaction management maturity and strict type-safe JVM thread isolation needed for banking ledgers.

tradeoffs: Higher baseline RAM consumption (512MB–1GB JVM memory floor).

database.justification: Multi-AZ synchronous replication with automated 30-second failover, continuous backups to S3, and physical data localization in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1).

alternatives.why_not: Fails automated multi-AZ failover and point-in-time recovery without complex manual Patroni setup.

hosting.justification: Serverless container compute in AWS Mumbai (ap-south-1) with VPC isolation, IAM roles, and certifications meeting RBI and PCI-DSS compliance.

alternatives.why_not: Requires manual OS patching, AMI baking, and custom auto-scaling scripts; Fargate eliminates operational maintenance.

tradeoffs: Containers do not scale to zero; minimum monthly container run cost applies.

supporting.justification: Durable, encrypted cloud object storage for user document and photo uploads with presigned URL access.

alternatives.why_not: Local container disks are ephemeral and lose user uploads on container restarts.

tradeoffs: Outbound internet data egress transfer costs.

supporting.justification: PCI-DSS compliant payment integration supporting cards, netbanking, and digital wallets without holding sensitive payment data.

alternatives.why_not: Stripe lacks native zero-fee UPI and Indian domestic netbanking settlement options.

supporting.justification: Authentication service resolving phone_otp requirements with secure token issuance.

alternatives.why_not: Building custom SMS OTP verification requires maintaining SMS gateways and credential token databases.

supporting.justification: Durable, exactly-once ordered message queue for decoupled background ledger processing and webhook delivery.

alternatives.why_not: RabbitMQ requires dedicated cluster maintenance, clustering plugins, and disk management.

tradeoffs: Throughput capped at 3,000 messages/sec with batching.

supporting.justification: Serverless model endpoint running credit scoring inference on demand, scaling to zero when idle.

alternatives.why_not: Dedicated GPU instances cost $150+/month even during zero-traffic idle periods.

tradeoffs: Initial cold start delay when spinning up idle containers.

supporting.justification: Vendor-neutral distributed tracing and metrics required to monitor SLA breaches and system health.

alternatives.why_not: Proprietary commercial observability with unpredictable host/metric volume bills.

tradeoffs: Requires configuring dashboard scraping and metric retention storage.

assumptions: Estimates based on published cloud pricing units and standard resource allocations.
